_comment: Pinned fosrl/newt release (Pangolin's tunnel client, CUR-1266). Bump deliberately, same way llama_version.json is bumped. sha256s computed by us at pin time -- newt's GitHub releases publish no checksums file. UNLIKE llama.cpp, these assets are single raw binaries, not tar.gz/zip archives -- no extraction step, just download + verify + chmod +x. Only linux-x64/linux-arm64 checksums have actually been downloaded and verified (this pin's local-dev/test target); darwin/windows entries are the real published filenames/URLs but their sha256 is a placeholder that MUST be verified (download once, compute sha256, replace) before relying on them -- see aipotluck/installer/newt_fetch.py's own warning on an unverified entry.
